versionTitle: 版本二：故宫多宝阁黑漆描金 × 宋代院体静物光影风 (Imperial Dark Lacquer & Song Court Still-Life)
title: 茶源风物·凤凰山古树单丛茶枝
prompt: Imperial Palace Museum Digital Duobaoge (数字多宝阁) curatorial aesthetic fused with Song Dynasty court academy realism (院体工笔重彩). Set against a deep polished ebony-lacquer and dark ink-pine void (#141C18 to #0D120F), illuminated by a single dramatic museum spotlight from top-left. Hyper-tactile heritage materials: luminous gilded lacquer, translucent porcelain glaze, aged bronze, hand-woven silk, and warm incense smoke. Strict 1:1 square composition with 50% velvety dark negative space, subtle gold-dust rim highlights (#B08A5A), timeless museum gravitas, strictly no text, no watermark, no artificial neon. Subject: Botanical and cultural study of a fresh Camellia sinensis branch from Chaozhou Phoenix Mountain alongside roasted twisted Dancong tea leaves.
